checked_profile.summary: Select Term and Instant Answer Term have different coverage and underwriting rules.
checked_profile.scope: Policy categories and selected term-product features. No single company-wide coverage range, medical-exam rule or premium is presented.

facts.label: Policy categories
facts.text: State Farm lists term, whole and universal life. Its term page names State Farm Life Insurance Company and State Farm Life and Accident Assurance Company, with different state licensing.

facts.label: Select Term
facts.text: Select Term offers 10-, 20- or 30-year initial terms. Premiums increase on renewal; the provider describes renewal up to age 95, subject to policy terms.

facts.label: Instant Answer Term
facts.text: This separate product advertises $50,000 of coverage until age 50 or for 10 years, whichever is longer. No physical or medical tests are required, but issuance depends on health answers and evidence of insurability. Same-day purchase is possible only if approved.
